plan: Deep-copy the recipe, traverse root and component ingredient lists, and resolve excluded ingredients through a deterministic catalog index.
Accumulate substitution effects for quantities, wording, equipment, yield, warnings, and chained additional ingredients.
Scale all adapted quantities with Fraction arithmetic, validate exclusions and equipment collectively, and return all sorted failure reasons when necessary.
mechanisms: Catalog choices are ordered by numeric priority and original catalog position.
Recursive ingredient resolution tracks substitution ancestry to detect cycles and processes additional ingredients through the same exclusion logic.
Instruction wording changes are accumulated and applied sequentially to every recipe/component instruction.
Equipment changes use normalized matching, then canonicalize names to entries in available_equipment so successful output is an exact subset.
copy.deepcopy and direct authored_text retrieval preserve input immutability and byte-for-byte original printing.
